summary: Two pinned ApxInf Metal implementations expose the same source-level row projection: one SIMDgroup owns a row, its lanes accumulate group-scaled packed-W8 vector dots, simd_sum combines the lane values, and lane zero publishes the result.
normalized_steps: Assign one logical output row to each SIMDgroup, with multiple row owners sharing a threadgroup.
Partition packed char4 columns across SIMDgroup lanes with the observed lane-strided traversal.
Select the row-local FP32 scale for each fixed group of 16 char4 values, representing 64 scalar INT8 weights.
Accumulate vectorized INT8-to-FP32 dot products multiplied by their group scale in one FP32 register per lane.
Reduce the lane accumulators with simd_sum.
Have lane zero publish the row result while leaving destination storage, bounds handling, NaN policy, and downstream synchronization to the enclosing operator.
observed_variants: The MLP projection permits a whole-SIMDgroup early return for an invalid row and writes a valid result directly to a device gate-up buffer.

The LM-head projection runs invalid rows through the reduction and publishes negative-infinity and maximum-token sentinels into threadgroup score-token arrays; it also maps a valid row's NaN sum to negative infinity while retaining that row's token.
